project.description: Uses the dbgap telemetry to grab sample counts for all in consents in uploaded file then update the sample_count for that consent File format is csv study_id, version, consent code number

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
need aws need jq need curl need csvgrep need csvcut need csvformat need in2csv
ROLE_ARN="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" ROLE_SESSION_NAME="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}"
METADATA_URI="${METADATA_URI:-s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/metadata_new_search.json}" MANAGED_INPUTS_URI="${MANAGED_INPUTS_URI:-s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/resources/Managed_Inputs.csv}"
API_BASE="${API_BASE:-http://dictionaryetl:8086/api}" SSTR_BASE="${SSTR_BASE:-https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gap/sstr/api/v1}"
cleanup() { rm -f "${assume_json:-}" 2>/dev/null || true unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN } trap cleanup EXIT
assume_role() { log "Assuming role ${ROLE_ARN}" assume_json="$(mktemp)" aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS" \ --role-arn "$ROLE_ARN" \ --role-session-name "$ROLE_SESSION_NAME" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json" unset assume_json }
# ----------------------------- # Prep workspace # ----------------------------- mkdir -p data rm -f metadata.json Managed_Inputs.csv data/Managed_Inputs.csv updated_studies.csv study_list.csv genomic_counts.csv
# ----------------------------- # Download inputs from S3 # ----------------------------- assume_role
log "Downloading metadata: ${METADATA_URI}" aws s3 cp "$METADATA_URI" metadata.json --no-progress
log "Downloading Managed_Inputs: ${MANAGED_INPUTS_URI}" aws s3 cp "$MANAGED_INPUTS_URI" Managed_Inputs.csv --no-progress aws s3 cp "$MANAGED_INPUTS_URI" data/Managed_Inputs.csv --no-progress
# ----------------------------- # Build updated studies list # ----------------------------- log "Computing updated studies list (ready=yes, processed=no)" #csvgrep -c "Data Processed" -m "No" data/Managed_Inputs.csv \ #| csvgrep -c "Data is ready to process" -m "Yes" \ #| csvcut -c "Study Identifier" \ #| csvformat -E \ #> updated_studies.csv csvgrep -c "Data is ready to process" -m "Yes" data/Managed_Inputs.csv \ | csvcut -c "Study Identifier" \ | csvformat -E \ > updated_studies.csv
# ----------------------------- # Build study list from metadata # - data_type contains "G" # - study_identifier contains "phs" # - consent_group_code: strip leading "c" (assumes it starts with c) # ----------------------------- log "Extracting study/version/consent from metadata.json" jq '.bio_data_catalyst[] | select(.data_type | contains("G")) | select(.study_identifier | contains("phs")) | { study_identifier: .study_identifier, study_version: .study_version, consent_group_code: (.consent_group_code | .[1:]) }' \ metadata.json \ | jq -s \ | in2csv -f json \ > study_list.csv
# ----------------------------- # Loop studies, query SSTR, update Dictionary ETL API # ----------------------------- log "Writing genomic_counts.csv" : > genomic_counts.csv
# Skip header safely tail -n +2 study_list.csv | while IFS=',' read -r stdy_id version consent; do stdy_id="${stdy_id//\"/}" version="${version//\"/}" consent="${consent//\"/}"
[[ -z "$stdy_id" || -z "$version" || -z "$consent" ]] && continue
if grep -Fxq "$stdy_id" updated_studies.csv; then log "Updating counts for ${stdy_id}.${version} consent=c${consent}"
# Fetch summary resp_file="${stdy_id}.c${consent}.response.json" curl --fail --retry 5 --show-error --silent \ -H 'accept: application/json' \ "${SSTR_BASE}/study/${stdy_id}.${version}/summary" \ > "$resp_file"
# Extract sample count (number, not null) count="$(jq -r --argjson c ${consent} '.study.consent_groups[] | select(.code == $c) | .sample_count' $resp_file | head -n 1)" echo count is $count if [[ -z "${count:-}" || "$count" == "null" ]]; then warn "No sample_count found for ${stdy_id}.${version} consent=c${consent}; skipping API update" continue fi
echo "${stdy_id},c${consent},${count}" >> genomic_counts.csv
# Update dictionary db via Dictionary ETL API curl --fail --show-error --silent \ --request PUT \ --data-urlencode "datasetRef=${stdy_id}" \ --data-urlencode "consentCode=c${consent}" \ --data-urlencode "sampleCount=${count}" \ "${API_BASE}/consent/counts" \ > /dev/null fi done
log "Done. Output: genomic_counts.csv"
